verdict.rationale: ClickHouse Cloud's pricing and marketing pages say compute scales up and down automatically with workload, scales to zero when idle, and supports user-set autoscaling limits, so the core automatic-scaling capability is the product's own. The evidence never says scaling happens without downtime or connection disruption, and it comes only from pricing and marketing pages, so coverage of the full story is incomplete. Missing for 10: evidence that scaling causes no downtime or interruption, in-depth technical autoscaling docs (triggers, granularity, scale-up latency, resume-from-zero behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Cloud autoscaling.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, compute autoscales up and down with load automatically, without manual resizes or downtime

citations.quote: We automatically scale up and down compute resources based on your workload
We automatically scale unused resources down to zero so that you don't pay for idle services
Set compute autoscaling limits to prevent runaway queries from unexpected bills
Start building instantly without having to size and scale your cluster.
